settings.title: Settings
settings.uiFontSizeHint: Sidebar and labels, 11–16 pt; the terminal font is set separately.
settings.reduceMotionHint: Turn off menu, dialog and notification animations.

settings.themePackHint: Install a theme plugin to add more palettes.

settings.languagePackHint: More languages appear here when language-pack plugins are installed.

settings.tabNumberingHint: Show a number before each session tab title.
settings.confirmClose: Confirm before closing a running session
settings.confirmCloseHint: Ask for confirmation when a tab with an active process is closed.
settings.sftpShowHiddenHint: New SFTP panes start with hidden files visible.
settings.transferConcurrencyHint: How many transfers may run at once (1–8). Paused transfers do not hold a slot.
settings.editorAutoSaveHint: Writes back 1.5 s after you stop typing, so editing a remote file uploads it. Off by default.
settings.appearanceHint: Changes apply to open terminals immediately.
settings.fontFamilyHint: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code and IBM Plex Mono are bundled; the rest use fonts installed on this device.
settings.scrollbackHint: Number of lines kept in terminal history.
settings.terminalInteractionHint: These take effect on open terminals immediately.
settings.bellHint: How to signal a BEL character sent by the remote program.
settings.rightClickPasteHint: Right-click pastes the clipboard directly. Turn off to open the context menu instead.
settings.scrollOnOutputHint: Follow new output as it arrives. Turn off to keep your reading position steady while output streams.
settings.autoCopyHint: Automatically copy selected text to the clipboard.
settings.sshSecurityHint: Global default for every SSH and SFTP host. Applies to newly opened connections; already connected sessions keep their negotiated algorithms.
settings.sshPresetHint: Recommended leaves the library's safe defaults untouched. Compatible adds SHA-1 / CBC / zlib for older appliances.
settings.sshAdvancedHint: Ticking any box switches the level to Custom. Names are listed strongest first; clearing a whole group keeps the library default for that group.
settings.autoSaveHint: Changes are saved to local settings instantly
settings.themeHint: Applies to the whole interface immediately. Imported themes and theme packs appear as additional choices.
settings.fontSizeHint: Terminal text size in points. Applies to open terminals immediately.
settings.cursorBlinkHint: Whether the terminal cursor blinks while idle.
settings.highlightColorHint: Colour used for the next keyword rule you add.
settings.restoreLayoutHint: Reopen the tabs and split layout saved from the previous session. Serial sessions are not restored.
settings.statusBarMonitorHint: Shows this machine when no session is active and the active tab's host otherwise. Hosts that cannot be sampled do not show it. Right-click the status bar to toggle it as well.

group.appearanceHint: Theme, language packs and terminal look. Changes are saved immediately.

group.transferHint: Remote file browsing and transfer behaviour.

monitor.killLocalHint: Local processes are managed by the operating system, so only remote hosts can be ended here.

forward.saveRuleHint: Saved rules start automatically when the host connects.

sync.title: Encrypted backup
sync.hint: Export hosts and tags into a passphrase-protected .ftbak file, or restore one. Restored hosts merge with existing data; duplicates are skipped.
sync.remoteHint: Upload the encrypted backup to a GitHub Gist or a WebDAV server. The passphrase above encrypts the payload before it leaves this device.
sync.gistIdPlaceholder: Leave empty to create a new secret gist
sync.gistIdHint: The ID is stored below after the first upload.
sync.downloaded: Downloaded backup: {added} hosts imported ({skipped} already present)
sync.desktopOnly: Cloud sync is available in the desktop app.
sync.deleteExtra: Delete extra entries in the target
sync.deleteExtraHint: Entries that do not exist in the source will be deleted from the target.
sync.summary: {dirs} folders, {files} files, {bytes} to copy, {deletes} to delete
sync.twoWayHint: Entries missing on either side are copied over; entries that differ on both sides are listed as conflicts.
sync.conflictHint: These names exist on both sides with different content. Pick the version to keep.
sync.conflictManual: File and folder clash — fix by hand
sync.deleteConfirmHint: These entries exist only in the target. Uncheck any you want to keep.
sync.secretHint: Stored encrypted; the value is never shown again.
sync.secretPlaceholder: Saved — enter a new value to replace
sync.includeSecrets: Include saved credentials (passwords, passphrases, managed key secrets)
sync.includeSecretsHint: Off by default. When enabled they are encrypted inside the same passphrase-protected backup.
sync.autoHint: Choose when encrypted backups are pushed to the remote. The passphrase is kept in this device's encrypted vault and never included in a backup.
sync.scopeHint: Credentials are excluded by default. Enable them only for a remote location you own and trust.
sync.syncNowFailed: Sync skipped. Check the remote settings and the saved passphrase.
sync.conflict: Upload refused: the remote bundle changed on another device. Pull it, or overwrite it deliberately.
sync.conflictShort: Sync conflict: the remote bundle changed on another device.
sync.statusConflict: The remote bundle changed on another device. Pull it, or overwrite it deliberately.
sync.passphraseSaved: Passphrase saved in the local encrypted vault
sync.passphraseNeeded: Enter a passphrase above to enable unattended sync
sync.versionsHint: Every sync and export leaves a sealed snapshot. Pick any point below to rewind; the current state is saved first so the rollback can be undone.
sync.versionsEmpty: No versions yet. Export a backup or run a sync first.
sync.restoreBody: Managed data from {time} will replace the current data in the scopes that version contains. A restore point of the current state is saved first, so you can roll back again.
sync.restored: Restored. A restore point was saved at {time}; select it to undo.

actionHint.enable: Stored secrets move into a vault encrypted with this password.
actionHint.change: Re-encrypt the vault with a new master password.
actionHint.disable: Stored secrets move back to the device-key vault.
actionHint.reset: Deletes every stored secret and returns to the device-key vault. Host and key metadata stays.

vault.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. There is no recovery if you forget it.
vault.errorWrongPassword: Master password is incorrect. Try again.

vault.resetUnderstood: I understand stored secrets will be deleted
vault.resetConfirmRequired: Confirm that you understand stored secrets will be deleted.

vault.modeLocal: Secrets are encrypted in a file on this device; the system keychain is not used.
vault.masterHint: Without a master password, secrets are protected only by file permissions on this device.
vault.autoLockHint: Only applies with a master password. Detection uses keyboard and pointer activity.
vault.desktopOnly: Credential management is available in the desktop app.

keys.title: SSH keys
keys.libraryHint: Keys imported or generated here live in the credential vault. Assign one to a host in the host properties.
keys.scanHint: Import a private key file that already exists on this device.
keys.pasteHint: Paste the full OpenSSH private key, including the BEGIN and END lines. The key is inspected locally and never leaves this device.
keys.clipboardEmpty: The clipboard does not contain text.
keys.clipboardError: Cannot read the clipboard; paste into the field instead.
keys.previewError: This text is not a valid OpenSSH private key.
keys.passphraseNeeded: A passphrase is required for this key; fill it in below.
keys.name: Display name
keys.notePlaceholder: e.g. bastion access, rotate every quarter
keys.expiresHint: Reminded here 30 days before the date. Leave empty for no reminder.

keys.rotateHint: Regenerate in place: host references stay valid, only the key material changes.

keys.backupHint: The public list is plain text and safe to share; the private-key bundle is encrypted with the passphrase above.
keys.bundlePassphrasePlaceholder: Required for both export and import
keys.importBundleHint: Paste a bundle exported from another install. Existing keys with the same fingerprint are skipped.
